title: alsine verna var. glacialis
intro: Alsine verna var. glacialis, commonly known as Glacier Wood Sorrel or White Alpine Sorrel, is a subspecies of the Wood Sorrel plant, characterized by its small, white or pinkish flowers and edible leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alsine verna var. glacialis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
